en: Today my birth has become fruitful, and today my ascetic penance has become fruitful;
today my knowledge has become fruitful, O Śambhu, through the sight of Your feet. (1)
I have achieved my purpose, I have achieved my purpose, I have achieved my purpose, O Maheśvara!
Today, through the sight of your lotus feet, O you who are affectionate toward your devotees. ||2||
"Śiva, Śambhu; Śiva, Śambhu; Śiva, Śambhu; Śiva, Śiva"—may my days pass and come as I thus constantly utter these words. (3)
May devotion to Śiva, devotion to Śiva, devotion to Śiva exist in birth after birth;
may it always exist, may it always exist, may it always exist most steadfastly. 4.
May he who, from birth until death, has no deity other than Mahādeva, not be born in my lineage; or if already born, may he perish instantly. (5)
May there never be birth in my lineage for any embodied being—whether already born, currently being born, or even dwelling in the womb—for whom Śambhu is not the deity. (6)
We are blessed, we are blessed, we are blessed in the three worlds, for the Primordial God, Mahādeva, is the tutelary deity of our lineage. (7)
O Hara, O Śambhu, O Mahādeva, O Lord of the Universe, O Beloved of the Immortals!
O Śiva, O Śaṅkara, O Soul of All, O Nīlakaṇṭha, salutations be unto you! 8.
Whoever recites this Agastyāṣṭaka in the presence of Śiva attains the world of Śiva and rejoices there together with Śiva. 9.
Thus ends the Śrīśivāṣṭaka composed by the venerable Agastya.
